tagline: Engineered antibody therapeutics for cancer and autoimmune diseases
hero_kpi_rationale: Milestone revenue is the primary indicator of progress in the biotech business model, reflecting clinical and regulatory advancement of strategic partnerships. It is a strong de-risking signal for the pipeline.

kpis.name: Milestone Revenue
kpis.explanation: Revenues recognized when a partner reaches a key milestone (clinical trial, regulatory approval)
kpis.description: Milestone revenues are tied to specific events in collaboration agreements. In 2025, Incyte triggered $37.5M in milestones (FDA submission + approval).
kpis.signal: Strong rebound in 2025 driven by regulatory milestones from Incyte

kpis.name: Royalty Revenue
kpis.explanation: Revenues earned on sales of drugs developed using our technology
kpis.description: Royalties derive from marketed drugs such as Ultomiris. Xencor also receives royalties on tafasitamab (Incyte).

kpis.name: Total Revenue
kpis.explanation: Sum of all revenues (licenses, milestones, royalties, collaboration)
kpis.description: Total revenue increased by $15.1M in 2025, driven by Incyte milestones and growth in Alexion royalties.
kpis.signal: Recovery in 2025 following a trough in 2023

kpis.name: R&D Expenses
kpis.explanation: Cash spent on developing new drugs and technologies
kpis.description: R&D expenses include clinical trials, manufacturing and internal costs. In 2025, they increased with the advancement of certain candidates into advanced clinical stages.
kpis.signal: R&D rising with advancement of clinical programs

kpis.name: Operating Loss
kpis.explanation: Amount lost by the company before taxes and other income
kpis.description: The company remains in operating loss, typical for a biotech in clinical stage. The loss is stable despite revenue growth.

kpis.name: License Revenue
kpis.explanation: Revenues earned for access to XmAb technology
kpis.description: In 2025, license revenues primarily derive from the Mabgeek agreement (upfront of $1.5M recognized in 2024) and Vir Bio.
kpis.signal: One-time revenues tied to discrete licensing deals

kpis.name: Net Income
kpis.description: Net income extracted from SEC EDGAR companyfacts XBRL over the last 8 reported fiscal years (10-K).
kpis.signal: Net income of -$0.092 billion last fiscal year (FY2025).

kpis.name: Operating Income
kpis.description: Operating income extracted from SEC EDGAR companyfacts XBRL over the last 8 reported fiscal years (10-K).
kpis.signal: Operating income of -$0.178 billion last fiscal year (FY2025).

kpis.name: Incyte Milestones
kpis.explanation: Amount received when Incyte achieves a key milestone with tafasitamab
kpis.description: In 2025, two major regulatory milestones were achieved at Incyte: sBLA submission ($12.5M) and approval ($25M). A third milestone of $4M was triggered in January 2026 with Phase 2 initiation.
kpis.signal: FDA acceptance and approval in 2025 = triggering of $37.5M

kpis.name: Amgen Phase 3 Milestone
kpis.explanation: Payment triggered by the initiation of a Phase 3 trial with a bispecific antibody
kpis.description: In December 2024, Amgen initiated a Phase 3 trial for xaluritamig, triggering a $30M payment received in January 2025.
kpis.signal: Amgen launches Phase 3 trial, sign of candidate maturity

risks.title: XmAb platform dependency
risks.score_rationale: The company is heavily dependent on its XmAb platform, and any technical issue could have a material impact on its business. (Item 1A)

risks.title: Regulatory risks
risks.score_rationale: The company is subject to strict regulation by agencies such as the FDA, and any non-compliance could have serious consequences. (Item 1A)

risks.title: Funding needs
risks.score_rationale: The company requires funding to continue R&D activities, and any funding disruption could materially impact its business. (Item 1A)

risks.title: Intense competitive environment
risks.score_rationale: The company operates in a highly competitive biopharmaceutical sector with many innovative competitors. (Item 1A)

risks.title: Clinical trial risks
risks.score_rationale: The company is exposed to risks related to clinical trials, such as delays, failures or unexpected results. (Item 1A)

ai_positioning.summary: No significant mention of artificial intelligence, machine learning or related technologies is present in the 10-K document.
